# Casa Santana (Aldanmar Apartments)

> Casa Santana is a 210 sqm beachfront residential triplex for sale by owner and builder on Dulangan Beach, Puerto Galera, Oriental Mindoro, Philippines (https://deanwestbury.com/). It features three fully furnished, self-contained apartments (Blue, Red, and Green) with immediate rental revenue, clean titled ownership, and a 6KW off-grid solar system.

## Key Property Facts

- **Asking Price**: ₱15,000,000 PHP (~$268,000 USD) — Direct Owner Sale (no broker markups)
- **Property Type**: 3-story beachfront multi-unit residential triplex villa
- **Address**: 164 Dulangan Road, Sitio Centro, Dulangan, Puerto Galera, Oriental Mindoro 5203, Philippines
- **GPS Coordinates**: 13.5042° N, 120.9856° E
- **Living Area**: ~210 sqm residential triplex (plus terraced balconies, enclosed garage, and off-road parking)
- **Occupancy & Revenue**: The Red and Green apartments are currently rented out (generating immediate rental income); the Blue apartment is inhabited by the owners.
- **Title & Permits**: Clean Titled Property · Real estate taxes paid up to date · Original building permits available · Occupancy permit available upon request
- **Energy & Utilities**: 6KW off-grid solar power system with battery bank (Blue unit), split-type inverter ACs across all units, independent electric meters per unit, shared filtered water supply
- **Parking**: Enclosed garage accommodates 1 medium car + off-road parking for 5 motorcycles
- **Direct Owner Contact**: aldanmar@deanwestbury.com

## Pages & Apartments

- [Main Triplex Listing & Overview](https://deanwestbury.com/): Complete property summary, exterior views, 3D cutaway & dimensioned floor plans, strategic distances, interactive map, and direct owner enquiry form.
- [The Blue Apartment (Owner 2-Bedroom Suite)](https://deanwestbury.com/?unit=blue): Upper road-level residence inhabited by owners; 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, 6KW off-grid solar system, 2.5HP living room + 1HP main bedroom split inverter ACs, panoramic ocean veranda, stair-free access near the garage.
- [The Red Apartment (Rented 1-Bedroom Sunrise Suite)](https://deanwestbury.com/?unit=red): Middle split-level residence; currently rented out generating immediate cash flow; private exterior entrance, internal stairs, sunrise ocean-view veranda, split-type inverter AC, separate electric meter.
- [The Green Apartment (Rented 1-Bedroom Garden & Beach Suite)](https://deanwestbury.com/?unit=green): Lower split-level coastal residence; currently rented out generating passive rental revenue; private exterior entrance, palm-shaded terrace, split-type inverter AC, separate electric meter, direct gated walkout onto Dulangan Beach.

## Location & Strategic Distances

- **Dulangan Beach Frontage**: 0 meters — direct walkout onto calm, protected, swimmable waters
- **Muelle Cultural Port & Marina**: 10–12 minutes drive — fast craft ferry terminal connecting to Batangas and Metro Manila
- **Sabang Scuba Diving Sanctuary**: 15 minutes drive — 30+ Coral Triangle dive sites, dining, and amenities
- **Tamaraw & Tukuran Waterfalls**: 15–25 minutes drive — tropical rainforest waterfalls and mountain pools
